vBRIEFInfo.description: Project scaffold: tsup build, package.json exports map, Vitest config, Taskfile

narratives.Description: Bootstrap the project toolchain. package.json with ESM + CJS dual package exports map (main, module, exports), TypeScript strict config (tsconfig.json), tsup.config.ts with two entry points (src/index.ts and each src/transports/*-adapter.ts) producing dist/esm/ and dist/cjs/ with .d.ts declarations. vitest.config.ts configured for Node.js + browser mode. Taskfile.yml with tasks: build, test, check (lint + typecheck + test), clean, dev. .gitignore covering dist/, node_modules/, coverage/. CHANGELOG.md stub with [Unreleased] section. README.md with install, quick-start, and transport adapter import examples. Includes directive/ Taskfile include so deft tasks are resolvable from project root.
narratives.Files: package.json, tsconfig.json, tsup.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, Taskfile.yml, .gitignore, CHANGELOG.md, README.md
narratives.Tests: Verified by: task build succeeds, task test passes with >= 85% coverage baseline on scaffold stubs, TypeScript strict compiles without errors.
